utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, but I’m trying not to pass along guesses—do you know the confirmed drop-off time, location, or who’s keeping the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, Quinn, so don’t share a firm time or location from me yet. Cleo’s the one starting the repair list, and I’m checking with her on the confirmed details and who’s handling the ledger.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Dane—I’ll tell folks Cleo’s starting the repair list, but I’ll hold off on time, location, and ledger until you or Cleo confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Nell. The simple plan is Saturday at 9, start at my place, bring the repair list, and we’ll confirm anything official with Marta or Cleo before changing course.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli—that helps a lot. I’ll bring the repair list Saturday at 9 and won’t treat anything as official unless Marta or Cleo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Nell. That keeps it tidy—come by at 9, and we’ll work down the list one house at a time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Kira — we’re aiming for Saturday late morning, about 10 to 1, and I’m still confirming who can handle the repair list and ledger; could you help with either of those?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can help with the repair list, but can you confirm whether the start is 9 at Eli’s or 10 to 1? I don’t want us labeling tools around the wrong window.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Kira — let’s stick with 10 to 1 on Saturday for now, and I’ll confirm if Eli’s 9 o’clock setup is just for early prep. I’d be grateful if you took the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Cleo—I'm still piecing it together, but I know tools and setup volunteers are being lined up. I promised to check who has the written repair list and ledger, so I can pass that along once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Noah—I’ll keep your check with Vik marked pending and won’t add any purchases until you hear who has the repair list and ledger.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo—that’s perfect. I’ll ask around about the written list and ledger, then circle back before anyone spends anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad folks are helping, Vik, but I still need the exact drop-off window, location, and supply list before I can promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I hear you, Pia—I don’t have the exact window, location, or supply list confirmed yet, so I’ll wait on Noah or a firm flyer before passing anything along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that helps. Once Noah or the flyer confirms the details, send them my way and I’ll see what I can safely take on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Hana! What I’ve heard so far is still tentative: around 10 Saturday in the community room by the laundromat, but I’m waiting on Marta, Faye, or the flyer before I call it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess—that sounds sensible. Once it’s confirmed, could you also check whether Rosa has the written repair list and who’s officially keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll check with Rosa about the written list and ask around about who’s keeping the ledger—once I hear it from Marta, Faye, or the flyer, I’ll pass it along as confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, before anyone buys supplies, do you know who’s writing the repair list and who’s keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Mina, I don’t want to guess and send folks shopping wrong—I need to check the sign-up sheet or ask Marta before I say who’s on the repair list and ledger.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please check with Marta today and tell Cleo and Faye who has those two jobs before we start buying anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara — quick version from me is it’s tentatively 10 Saturday in the community room by the laundromat, but Rosa’s the one coordinating, so I’m waiting on her or the flyer before I call it firm.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep saying tentative until Rosa or the flyer confirms it, and I’m pulling the repair list and tool offers together before I update everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Mara — once Rosa firms it up, just tell me if you need me on coffee, check-in, or some other simple job.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Jules — I’m tracking the repair drive as moved to Sunday at the community center, but I’m still waiting on Marta for the exact time and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal — I had been telling folks Saturday late morning, so I’ll pause that and let both groups know it’s now Sunday once Marta confirms the time and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thank you — I’ll keep Saturday off the notes and send you the confirmed Sunday time and drop-off spot as soon as Marta or Rosa locks it down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa, can you send me the latest list of what needs fixing and who’s already covering tools for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — quick correction first: it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. I’m firming up the repair list now, and Kira is helping sort tools and label donated parts, so I’ll send you the latest roster as soon as I’ve got the last details pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center, got it. Send the roster when it’s ready and I’ll update everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can’t be there Sunday, Rey, but I’ve got pliers, a wrench set, and a couple screwdrivers set aside if they’d help. I can label the bag and leave it by the back door tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — that would help a lot. I’ll make sure someone picks up the labeled bag tomorrow and gets it back to you after the drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rey. I’ll put my name on it and leave it by the back door in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, quick repair drive update while I’m out: Saturday late morning is still the plan, but we’re short on tables, a few tools, and a couple setup volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for the update, Ira—count me in for setup, and I can bring a folding table plus my drill, socket set, and a few hand tools Saturday late morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s perfect, Gus—thank you, I’ll mark you down for setup and those tools, and I’ll pass it along to Jules so the list stays current.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I’m happy to bring along some tools for the repair drive—just let me know what you’re short on, and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus — I’m still waiting on Noah to confirm what needs fixing first, but once I know what tools are short I’ll come find you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll keep my toolbox handy, and you can just give me a shout once Noah’s list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Hana, I’m still confirming the time and location, but it sounds like the leaky gutters by the community room and a few porch steps are the first priorities.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that helps, but before I commit, can you confirm whether Rosa has those priorities in writing and who’s officially keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have that confirmed yet, Hana, but I’ll check with Rosa about the written priorities and ask who’s keeping the ledger before I pass anything along as official.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mara, I’m almost set—Gus has tools covered, but I still need the final repair list and a check on volunteer coverage.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo—I’m checking the repair list with the organizers today, and I’ll also confirm volunteer coverage before we tell Gus what tools are actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Mara—send me the final list when you have it, and I’ll match it against Gus’s tools before confirming with him.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Dane — I’m helping with the repair drive Saturday morning, covering the 10–12 intake table and bringing masking tape, but I’m checking with Marta or Leo before sharing any exact details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — masking tape is on Cleo’s tentative list, but I’m still checking the confirmed repair list and who’s keeping the ledger before we treat anything as final.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Dane — I’ll hold off calling the masking tape final and won’t point anyone to details until Marta or Leo confirms the repair list, ledger person, and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Kira — I’m telling everyone Saturday late morning for the repair drive, and I’m checking with Rosa on the written repair list and who’s keeping the ledger before I send the full details around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday late morning, or 9 at Eli’s like Oren said? Please confirm with Rosa before that goes around, because I don’t want two start times floating around.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You’re right, Kira — I’ll hold off on sending anything else and confirm directly with Rosa whether it’s Saturday late morning or 9 at Eli’s before I update both groups.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal — quick version I’ve got is Saturday around 10 in the community room by the laundromat, but let’s treat it as tentative until Marta or the flyer confirms.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep it penciled in as Saturday around 10 at the community room by the laundromat, and I’ll check Marta or the flyer before I mark it final.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — if it’s confirmed, I’m happy to do something simple like coffee or check-in, just tell Rosa to point me where needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Nell! I’m hearing the repair drive is tentatively Saturday around 10 at the community room by the laundromat, but I’m still waiting on Faye’s clearer list of who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess—that matches the bits I’ve heard. I’ll check back with Quinn or Jules for the firmer tool list, and I can still cover the sign-up table if Rosa needs me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Nell — I’ll keep saying Saturday around 10 at the community room is tentative, and I’ll pass along that you can cover sign-ups if Rosa needs you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, before anyone buys supplies, do we have a named person writing the repair list and another keeping the ledger?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t have those names confirmed yet, Mina — Jules is closest to the logistics, so I’ll check with them before anyone spends money.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good — please ask Jules today, and don’t let purchases start until the repair list and ledger keeper are named.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, but I’m trying not to pass along guesses—do you know who has the confirmed time, place, or supply list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Quinn, bless you for being careful—I’d check with Marta or the flyer for the firm time and place, and I should peek at the sign-up sheet before saying anything about supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren—I’ll check Marta or the flyer for the time and place, and I’ll wait on the sign-up sheet before telling anyone what supplies to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Uli — that’s perfect. I’ll confirm the Sunday drop-off details today and make sure your labeled tools get where they need to go.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll put my name on the bag and leave it by the back door tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli, thank you — I’ll check in once I’ve got the pickup or Sunday drop-off plan confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli — we’re aiming for Saturday late morning, about 10 to 1, for the repair drive; could you help out, or bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help, Faye, though I had folks starting at 9 at my place, so let’s confirm the time with Marta before we shift it. I’ll bring my basic tools and keep the repair list handy.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — let’s hold off on changing the time until we check with Marta, and your tools plus the repair list would be a huge help.
